column1: # Per-file wall-time weights (ms, compile+run) for the unit-test battery.
# Drives the LPT shard partition in scripts/unit_test_runner.sh
# (VIBE_UNIT_TEST_SHARD=i/N). Weights only need to be APPROXIMATELY
# right — they balance shard loads; correctness never depends on them,
# and files missing here default to 1500ms.
# Measured 2026-07-25 on a 4-core linux box at -P4, stage2 @ 3b0df58
# distribution enough to warrant this refresh).
